safety_invariants: Scope/effective-date/issuer-currentness and product authorization checked before applying 2023 PSP timing rules
Receipt/notification timestamps are immutable and provenance-tagged; clocks from trusted services; no silent deadline recalculation

Recipient objection retains disputed funds and preserves judicial evidence; no unauthorized forced transfer
Original transaction and any return have separate immutable double-entry postings with distinct idempotency identities
Unknown return outcome must survive retries and DR; no blind reissue or double credit
Bank/PSP entitlements, BEAC profile and external settlement evidence are independent from public platform launch
Cross-tenant cases, data retention, court order, fraud and AML holds require explicit institution rules and access controls
